schemaVersion.description: The major version of this contract

id.description: 64 lowercase hex digits. Opaque to readers

producer.description: A stable name for the suite or tool. With the check id, environment and parameters it picks the slot a layer fills

recordedAtMs.description: When the checks ran, in epoch milliseconds. The newest completed result wins its slot

sha.description: The commit the checks ran against. Provenance only; it never partitions a report

runUrl.description: Where to read the CI run that produced it

environment.description: The client that was checked: desktop-web, mobile-web, ios, android, or any other lowercase name

parameters.description: Other choices that make a result its own slot, such as a device size

freshness.description: `modified`: recorded from a checkout with uncommitted changes. `unknown`: origin not captured

fingerprint.description: Identity of the spec text the layer was recorded against, to warn when the spec changed since

sha.description: Repeats the layer sha; readers use the layer

kind.description: An open category: behavior, performance, accessibility… A new kind needs no change to a reader

id.description: The check's stable identity within its producer. The same check must keep the same id in every layer, or layers cannot replace one another

detail.description: Why it failed, or what was measured

specPath.description: The spec this check belongs to, relative to the repository, such as specs/join.feature

limit.description: The allowance. A measurement over it is reported, and never fails the check by itself

durationMs.description: How long the check took, when the producer measured it

tags.description: Free labels to filter and group by: smoke, slow, flaky…

labels.description: Facts about the result, not part of its identity: owner, severity, browser, os, build. Unlike `parameters` they never split a result into another slot

rel.description: Why it is linked, in an open vocabulary: issue, run, trace, docs, source…

id.description: Lets another attachment, step or annotation refer to this one

contentType.description: An IANA media type. Absent means application/octet-stream

bundleKey.description: The key of its bytes in the layer

uri.description: Where else to read it: an https URL, or a path a host understands

poster.description: The `id` of an attachment that stands for this one before it is opened

captions.description: The `id`s of attachments (WebVTT, SRT) that caption this one

type.description: An open vocabulary: note, warning, deprecation, issue, accessibility, coverage…

level.description: Conventionally info, warning or error. Anything else is shown as a note

rel.description: Why it is linked, in an open vocabulary: issue, run, trace, docs, source…

kind.description: An open vocabulary: action, assertion, hook, request, span, given, when, then…

status.description: Conventionally passed, failed, skipped. Anything else is shown as it is

offsetMs.description: When it started, after the check did
